title: Full digest — intake gate through colon (stage sequence)

basedOn: Top-level sequence over all eight stages: oral -> stomach -> duodenum -> jejunum -> portal -> systemic -> cell -> colon (the last four are post-absorptive / off-lumen). Micro-steps live in each stage file, not here. Teaching model - no product score implied.

intakeGate.label: Intake gate
intakeGate.detail: If the host is explicitly not ready, or every intake channel is 0, stop before the mouth - don't invent a meal path. Legacy events with unset intake flags proceed.

choices.note: Host not ready - process ends before the mouth.

stopNoHost.label: Stop - host not ready
stopNoHost.detail: Process terminated before intake. Complete host setup; do not invent a meal path.

stopEmpty.label: Stop - empty intake
stopEmpty.detail: Process terminated before intake. Set at least one of intake.food | hydration | supplement = 1.

oral.label: Mouth & esophagus
oral.detail: Run stage.oral - cephalic cue through the LES handoff.

stomach.label: Stomach
stomach.detail: Run stage.stomach - acid, pepsin, gastric emptying control.

duodenum.label: Duodenum
duodenum.detail: Run stage.duodenum - bicarbonate neutralization, bile, pancreatic enzymes.

jejunum.label: Jejunum / ileum
jejunum.detail: Run stage.jejunum - villus absorption and anabolic/basal routing.

systemic.label: Systemic circulation
systemic.detail: Run stage.systemic - peripheral appearance and clearance shape.

colon.label: Colon & rectum
colon.detail: Run stage.colon - fermentation, SCFA, water reclamation.

complete.label: Process complete
complete.detail: Full digest sequence finished. Drill into each stage:* emit for micro-steps. No product score implied.
